NewsArticle.Title: 40 New Clothing Variations (Circle 3)
NewsArticle.Content:
40 new clothing variations appear in Client 2.26. These are regional variations of Circle 3 clothing, which is the clothing you are able to wear in each class at level 41 (Warrior receive Circle 3 at level 26), known as the distinguished garments. For example, the Mantle, Paluten, Lorica, Elle, Corsette, and more.
The regional tailoring technique is the same as Circle 1 and Circle 2 regional tailoring. A tailor and respected citizen can learn the art of regional tailoring. Go to one of the mundane tailors of the four regions: Mileth, Rucesion, Suomi, and Loures.
